title: Tracking scalar unification requires a depletion branch between early and late energy
assumptions: One canonical positive-potential scalar provides early and late energy; smooth rolling depletion is approximated by successive constant-slope regimes.
EDE normalization fixes illustrative lambda_early^2=40; residual fraction target is order 1%; lambda_late^2=0.25 is a benchmark, not a fit.
Source sign/convention corrections must precede implementation; background trajectory does not close the observational/perturbation test.
predictions: Uncoupled same-slope radiation and matter tracking fractions are 4/lambda^2 and 3/lambda^2; their ratio 3/4 leaves excessive residual early energy in the paper framework.
Intermediate lambda_mid^2 about 300 lowers the matter-tracking level to order 0.01; a logistic shoulder gives lambda_mid=lambda_early+n/Delta and later shallow behavior.
Predicted five-regime history is a conditional background possibility, not a full CMB solution or demonstrated UV model.
